completed_stage_receipts.summary: Classified the challenge as a maintenance meta-method defect: a locally complete audit can still omit mature architecture/reliability question families. Named frameworks are evidence lenses, not mandated mechanisms.
Requirement: build a cold non-authoritative benchmark library, diagnose Universal gaps, and hold all production refactor until later explicit authorization.

Mapped lifecycle/decomposition, control/reconciliation, authority/change, owner interactions, environments, durable execution lineage, supervision/recovery, reliability, assurance, formal correctness, hazards, learning and resilience.

The direct-main Contents-API deviation recurred after an accepted HEAD-CAS rule. This is RECURRED_AFTER_FIX. The prior repair relied on cold-path policy/Handoff and regression text; recurrence requires escalation above that control level. Root cause is operator dependence because the critical mutation route is not explicit in mandatory Continuity bootstrap authority.

Re-observed current public/official architecture evidence for the 2026 agent-runtime set and source-access boundaries. Full normative DO-178C and IEC 61508 text is not treated as a fully studied corpus; public FAA/IEC material remains only an evidence lens. UVM remains studyable from public Accellera material.

Reuse existing authority: ENTRYPOINT is the mandatory bootstrap surface, PROGRESS_OBSERVABILITY_POLICY already owns detailed direct-main mutation semantics, and existing regression tests already cover the detailed policy. No new root mutation policy or PR-first subsystem is needed.

Rejected framework-by-framework transplantation, universal PR-first, a new parallel mutation policy, and a generic Agent Runtime abstraction. Selected minimal escalation: make the existing HEAD-CAS prohibition explicit in ENTRYPOINT and regression-bind it while retaining detailed semantics in the existing policy.

User authorization is bounded to source pruning/demotion and applicability screening. It does not authorize blanket production refactor. Internal repair of the recurrent main-mutation process defect remains autonomous system maintenance.

Because the recurrence is caused by the route invariant not being present on mandatory bootstrap, ENTRYPOINT is the correct higher-level activation surface. Add only a compact delegation rule; do not copy detailed mutation doctrine into bootstrap.

Complexity budget: no new authority root, no PR workflow, no new agent, no framework zoo. Research applicability collapses into six primitive families. The mutation repair adds only a short bootstrap invariant plus regression coverage.

Payoff is high relative to cost: recurring operator-route omission is addressed at mandatory bootstrap; inaccessible normative standards are removed from the full-study count; retained research is consolidated rather than expanded. No superseded production subsystem needs coexistence.

Implemented the smallest higher-abstraction repair and research-scope cleanup. ENTRYPOINT now forbids material Contents-API main writes when HEAD-CAS primitives exist and delegates details to the existing progress policy; regression coverage binds this bootstrap rule. DO-178C/IEC 61508 paid normative standards are removed from the current full-study framework set, public FAA/IEC evidence lenses remain bounded, UVM remains retained, and 22_applicability_screen is the current six-primitive applicability view. No production architecture refactor was applied.
